content.text: Evaluate only visible evidence. Frame roles are temporal labels, not proof of success.

Evaluate only the current declared condition and its supplied current-step evidence. Prior workflow progress and later actions are outside this result check. Do not repeat checks of earlier steps or infer requirements from future tasks.

choices.description: Visible evidence establishes the declared current result.
Visible evidence contradicts the declared current result.
Required evidence is missing, hidden or ambiguous.

questions.instructions: Inspect the current screenshot for this condition: "Installing requests has finished successfully on this computer.". Select condition_met only when the stated visible result is established; condition_not_met when the image establishes a conflicting state; evidence_insufficient when required evidence is missing. Do not infer earlier actions, future steps, temporal progress or hidden persistence from one static frame.
